metadata.description: Personal skills packaged as plugins for Claude Code and Codex.

plugins.name: general
plugins.description: k-ymmt's general-purpose skills: ask-until-clear (do the task, asking about every unclear point) and codex-adversarial-review (adversarial second-opinion review via codex exec, run at the end of a work session). ask-until-clear is user-invoked only.

plugins.name: apple-platform-build
plugins.description: Build, test, and verify iOS/macOS/watchOS/tvOS/visionOS projects through Xcode's own MCP server (xcrun mcpbridge), falling back to xcodebuild when Xcode is not running. Includes simulator-verify, which drives an app in the iOS Simulator to check flows, crashes, logs and layout, and the apvt skill, which finds layout mistakes in a running simulator app.
